title: 1 Timothy Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 1 Timothy 4: what the Spirit says about later times, the value of godliness, and the charge to a young teacher.

questions.text: What does the Spirit say some will pay attention to in later times?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons.

answers.text: Kings and those in high places
Seducing spirits and doctrines of demons

questions.text: How does verse 2 describe the conscience of these men who speak lies?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says they are branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron.

answers.text: Branded as with a hot iron

questions.text: What do they forbid, and what do they command?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says they forbid marriage and command to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving.

answers.text: They forbid prayer and command long fasts
They forbid teaching and command silence
They forbid marriage and command to abstain from foods
They forbid travel and command gifts

questions.text: On what condition is nothing of God's creation to be rejected?
questions.explanation: Verses 4 and 5 say every creature of God is good and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving, for it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

answers.text: If it is received with thanksgiving
If the elders have blessed it
If it is eaten in the assembly

questions.text: What is Timothy told to refuse in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise yourself toward godliness.

questions.text: What has value in all things, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, with the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

questions.text: In what is Timothy to be an example to those who believe?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: let no man despise your youth, but be an example in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

answers.text: In word, love, faith, and purity

questions.text: To what is he to pay attention until the writer comes?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says: until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

answers.text: The poor, the widows, and the sick
The elders, the servants, and the young

questions.text: How was the gift that is in him given, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says the gift was given to him by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

answers.text: By the choice of the assembly
By prophecy, with the laying on of hands

questions.text: What will happen if he continues in these things, according to verse 16?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says that in doing this he will save both himself and those who hear him.

answers.text: He will be counted worthy of double honor
He will save himself and those who hear him
He will be an example to the elders
